eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed lower after failing to sustain early gains, with both major benchmarks declining over 1%. The session saw volatility as markets initially rallied on reduced uncertainty before surrendering advances. While some sectors showed resilience, broader sentiment turned cautious amid global macroeconomic crosscurrents and currency pressures. Energy stocks remained in focus amid shifting crude forecasts, though financials outperformed the wider downturn.
